programs.title: Bamay
programs.sub_title: Barkinji Country - The Barkaa NSW Part 2
programs.desc: A slow TV showcase of the stunning landscapes found in Madi Madi, Dadi Dadi and Nganguruku Country along the waters of the Murrumbidgee River.

programs.title: Toi Time
programs.desc: Meet Tama, Maia, Jojo, Buzz and their whanau Aunty Anika, Wolfy, Oma and Mohio as they learn about numbers.

programs.title: Waabiny Time
programs.desc: Kedala, day-time for the ngaangk, the sun and kedalak, night-time is when the miyak the moon comes out.

programs.title: Birds Eye View
programs.desc: Meet Tui, Pukeko, Kereru and Piwakawaka: four chatty birds who love to people watch. They can't believe the absurdity of these modern day humans.

programs.title: Aussie Bush Tales
programs.desc: Three mischievous Aboriginal boys and their cousin Jedda always followed by their dingo puppy Snowy, go exploring and investigate new and exciting mysteries in the Aussie Bush.

programs.title: The Mysterious Cities Of Gold
programs.desc: The children finally manage to penetrate the ziggurat. They start their descent in search of the sacred sails of Princess Rana'Ori in the bowels of the pyramid, where they should be found.
